category_title: Low socially competent children who engage in disruptive alternative activities when bored
minimal_context: The student is showing her family tree project in her notebook to her peers in the classroom.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Please show your family tree project in your notebook to the rest of the group.

STUDENT: I wrote down the names I wanted.

TUTOR: Some of the other children are saying that one of the names is wrong.

STUDENT: (Says with a firm tone and expresses frustration) Kerttu, Kerttu is a girl's name!

TUTOR: Let's keep talking about your project.

STUDENT: (Is quiet for a while, then begins to express being hurt and puts her notebook away. The communication ends.)

options.A: Walk around the classroom, conference with students, and sit in to observe and record interactions.
options.B: Walk around the classroom and stand behind the student during the presentation.
options.C: Make sure that the presentation is accurate and meets the family tree project objectives.
options.D: Provide help in the form of giving instructions for solving the conflict.
